tagline: Game monsters, scene handover and an easier lobby to join.

entries.headline: Spawn the game's monsters, hand your scene over to another GM without losing anything, and join a lobby with a single command.

sections.title: Monsters
items: New "Monsters" category in the Field tab: search for a game animal or monster by name, or copy the one you are targeting.
Monsters have the same bars, stats and rolls as NPCs. They arrive as enemies and share the 8 NPC slots.
Players still on 2.0.2 see a human NPC instead of the monster.
Pin your favorite monsters to find them without searching.

sections.title: Scene handover
items: When the GM gives away the party lead, their markers (stats included) and NPCs go to the new leader, who picks the scene up where it was.
If the GM leaves the party, the co-GM takes over the scene, or the new party leader if there is no co-GM.
In a lobby, the GM leaving hands the lobby over to their co-GM instead of closing it.
NPCs no longer stay on screen with nobody able to remove them after a lead change.

sections.title: Lobby
items: "Copy invitation" copies a command to paste in chat: /masterevent join followed by the code.
The code field accepts the whole invitation, a lowercase or spaced code, and Enter confirms it.
Members of the GM's party join the lobby without a code and see it in their player view.
A lobby code joined more than 12 hours ago is forgotten at startup.
The Lobby card shows the command to type and where to enter the code in the player view.

sections.title: Interface
items: Settings now gathers everything: the configuration window is gone, the plugin installer's cog opens Settings directly, and search takes you to the chosen setting.
Weather and time share a single "Ambiance" card, with one "Apply to the scene" button and what is applied shown at the top.
Redesigned Group screen: access requests at the top, connection status readable without relying on color, rare actions in a "..." menu.
Creating an NPC now goes by source (Copy my look, .chara, MCDF, Glamourer) with a single "Spawn" button.
Destructive actions (remove, close, end combat) ask for confirmation; solid red is kept for that step.
GM roll requests open in a window at the center of the screen, above the health bars.
Time is set on a notched slider, like transparency.
In access requests, "Accept" is green and "Decline" is red.
Higher-contrast secondary text and easier-to-hit buttons.

sections.title: Fixes
items: "Accept modded NPCs from GMs" is now enabled by default, existing configurations included.
Out of combat, the player view shows "No turn has started yet." instead of "Waiting for the GM...".
"In session (1 player)" is now singular.
The Ether bar no longer shows when the template does not use it, and a GM taking over a scene applies their own template's rules.
The incompatible version warning now shows in orange.
